messages.content: What is the meaning of the word indolent I ND OL ENT

message.content:
**Indolent** means **lazy**, **idle**, or **not willing to work or make effort**.[1][4][5]

It can also be used in medicine to describe something that is **slow-growing**, **slow to heal**, or **causing little pain**.[1][2][4]
